candidates.reason: Rearranges the design properly for the banner (headline centred, details left, can middle, CTA right), but it reads as three loose zones: the RSVP button and URL float in the lower right with no shared edge or axis; the gap between the FREE ENTRY and ALL AGES pills is wider than the one after it; the pill and detail text is small; the can sits low and unanchored; and the bottom-left is empty.

The headline and CTA are strong, but the pills are split up: FREE ENTRY is stranded under the details while ALL AGES and TASTINGS sit above RSVP. The partner placeholder butts right against the end of the URL line. The sun circle sits behind the 'Sunset' headline. The can is pushed to the right edge and crowded.

This is a shrunk copy of the square original, not a rearrangement. The pill labels, the details line and the URL are too small to read. The whole thing is a narrow centre column with large dead side margins and an empty band below the pills. The circle has moved to sit behind the headline block.

The CTA is buried: 'RSVP Free' is shrunk into a small pill the same size as the info tags, which breaks the hierarchy. Reading order is jumbled, with 'Solstice Presents' and the tagline sitting left of and below the headline. The big empty band between the pills and the URL row, and the large gap from the URL to the placeholder, leave the layout bottom-heavy and unbalanced.
